title: Binance Futures Will Adjust The Contract Size of USDⓈ-Margined SPCXUSDT Pre-IPO Perp (2026-06-10)
text: This is a general Binance Exchange Notice and a Notice for the purposes of the Clearing Rules. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region.  Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will  adjust the Contract Size  of USDⓈ-Margined   SPCXUSDT Pre-IPO Perp commencing at  2026-06-10 08:30 (UTC) . The adjustment will take 15 to 30 minutes to complete (the “ Adjustment Period ”). There will be a cancel-only phase which may last up to 5 minutes after the adjustment is complete. More details on the adjustment can be found in the table below:  USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contract SPCXUSDT Estimated Share Count as of 2026-05-21*  11.87 billion shares *The estimated share count is based on the  listing announcement  published on 2026-05-21. Revised Estimated Share Count* 13.08 billion shares *The revised estimated share count is based on the amount disclosed in  S-1/A  (as published on the SEC website). The actual share count might be different if the issuer updates the filing before Official IPO Listing. If the difference between updated share count and revised estimated share count on 2026-06-10 before the Official IPO listing is less than 3%, no Contract Size adjustment will be made. Binance may adjust the Contract Size when a new proposed share count is available. A separate announcement will be made if Binance adjusts the Contract Size. Adjustment Scale Factor 1.10 The impact of Contract Size adjustment Example: A user has a long open position in SPCXUSDT Pre-IPO Perp with a contract size of 5,000 SPCX at average entry price at 180 USDT. The mark price 2026-06-10 08:30 (UTC) is 165 USDT. Before the Adjustment After the Adjustment Mark Price (USDT) 165 165/1.10 = 150 Contract Size (SPCX) 5,000 5,000 * 1.1 = 5,500 Average Entry Price (USDT) 180 150 Unrealised PNL (165 - 180) * 5,000 = -75,000 0  Notional Position (USDT) 180 * 5,000 = 900,000 150 * 5,500 = 825,000 Margin Balance 900,000 + (-75,000) = 825,000 825,000 Note: There is a minor rounding difference in price and contract size after the Contract Size is adjusted. The price will be adjusted according to the tick size while the contract size will be adjusted to minimum trade amount.  Please Note:   At  2026-06-10 08:20 (UTC) , all strategy bots created on the aforementioned perpetual contract (including Grid, DCA and Snowball) will be terminated and all positions will be closed automatically regardless whether "Close all positions on stop" is enabled or not. The position of all strategy bots will  not  be reinstated after the Adjustment is complete.  During the Adjustment Period, a Halt Session State will be implemented and all the open orders in the aforementioned perpetual contract, including reduce-only orders (TP/SL), will be canceled. Services of the aforementioned perpetual contract such as trading, closing position, order (placement, cancellation and modification) and liquidation functions will be suspended during the Adjustment Period. It is recommended that users with open positions in the aforementioned perpetual contract re-assess their position before the adjustment to mitigate against price fluctuations that may occur. During the cancel-only phase, users are allowed to submit, modify or cancel Post-Only orders only. The duration of the cancel-only phase will be determined by Binance based on actual market liquidity and may last up to 5 minutes. The continuous Kline (candlestick) chart of the aforementioned perpetual contract before the adjustment will be retained and continued with the newly adjusted price.  The adjustment completion could be completed ahead of the schedule. API users may use GET /fapi/v1/exchangeInfo and UI users can refer to this  page  to check the latest trading status of the Pre-IPO Perp during the adjustment process. If the adjustment takes more than 30 minutes to complete, a separate announcement will be made. Assume the Contract Size Adjustment takes 25 minutes to complete, below is the trading status of the the aforementioned perpetual contract:  Timeline Description Trading Status Before 2026-06-10 08:30 (UTC) Before the Contract Size Adjustment TRADING  From 2026-06-10 08:30 (UTC)  to 2026-06-10 08:55 (UTC) The Contract Size Adjustment process starts TRADING_HALT From 2026-06-10 08:55 (UTC to 2026-06-10 09:00 (UTC) The cancel-only phase after the contract size adjustment process completes TRADING_CANCEL_ONLY After 2026-06-10 09:00 (UTC) The trading function resumes TRADING This information is released in accordance with paragraph 20 of the  Contract Specifications . This information specified in this notice should not be construed as financial, legal or other professional advice. For legal terms applicable to Pre-IPO Perps, please refer to the  Terms of Use , the  Exchange Rules  (including the  Exchange Procedures ) and the  Clearing Rules  (including the  Clearing Procedures ). Additional terms and conditions will also be set out in the  Contract Specifications . There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Further Information: Perpetual Futures on Traditional Assets The Contract Size of the Pre-IPO Perp Adjustment Trading Rules to Trading Parameter Mark Price and Price Index Binance Futures Contract Specification   Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2026-06-08
